verdict.rationale: Navan's developer portal documents an official MCP server at developer.navan.com/mcp. It connects Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Codex and OpenClaw to Navan spend, travel, policy and card data through natural-language queries, and the probe confirms both the MCP page and an MCP-focused llms.txt are live. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works, documented setup/auth details for the MCP connection, and clarity on whether the MCP supports write actions beyond querying.
